card.learned_from: Imhof《地形的地图表现》（1965）、Minard 的拿破仑远征图（1869）
card.line: 晕渲地形、海岸和河流，镜头从高处推近并压低，路线一段段长出来，每站标上编号和海拔
card.fit: 地理、历史行军、旅行、物流路线
card.score: 开阔的弦乐和竖琴，D 大调
card.instruments: 竖琴分解和弦、弦乐长音、铜管渐强
card.sounds_like: 高空的风，每段路线一口上扬的气，每个站点一声轻的弹响

motion.camera: zoom in log space ×1.85, pitch 0° → 35–37°, in-out; the far edge pales with the tilt
motion.route: each leg 0.7–0.8 s on an in-out sine, a band 10 map px wide with an arrowhead while it grows

texture.relief: light from the north-west 29° up, vertical exaggeration 26, contrast rising with height

study.work: Carte figurative des pertes successives en hommes de l'Armée Française dans la campagne de Russie 1812–1813
